semanticBoundary: Candidate signals are forensic cues only. Even a matching source label or monetary value does not prove exact source-row identity, highlight precision, variant, currency column, marker, qualifier, or complete crop. These known source-confirmed false foci calibrate candidate detection but do not grant a semantic pass to any record. Missing candidate hits do not establish correctness.
preservedUnknowns: Across all3097 geometry observations, 1575 remain unassessed; 115 have no candidate signal but are explicitly witness-observed-no-semantic-pass.
Across all2161 records, 859 have no supported explicit numeric extraction and remain unknown or not applicable rather than negative evidence.
The full-corpus categories are overlapping; category observation totals are not unique rows or defects.
limits: All signals are candidates. Numeric matches can be hit points, dice, other columns, or neighboring rows. A matching label and amount never approves precision, variants, values, currency columns, markers, or qualifiers.
Text boxes crossing a boundary require pixel adjudication; font padding can cross without clipped ink.
Literal label witnesses are limited to declared UA row labels and canonical sourceObject labels; other logical owner labels remain unavailable.
Nonzero CropBox PDF-point declarations remain ambiguous without a producer frame contract. Render conversions require recorded dimensions and DPI.
No private source word text, full OCR, or original PDF path is included. Public tests use synthetic word boxes; original PDFs are optional offline inputs.

Expected values use an explicit partial field allowlist; missing extraction is unknown or not applicable, never proof of no monetary amount. Fields such as minimumPerApplicantLevel/basinCostGp/fontCostGp and source fraction glyphs require further adapters.
New discovery corpora outside the exact input manifest remain unassessed and are not covered by this report.

positiveSourceControl.scope: Isolated complete focus observed by original-source QA; no value/default/qualifier-grade promotion made here.
positiveSourceControl.interpretation: Source QA identifies the row17 focus as isolated; the witness still emits a text-box-crossing candidate. This is a candidate-only boundary signal, not a negative semantic judgment.
